TestScyllaTop::test_default_start.description: Starts 3 nodes, runs scyllatop without -b for 10s then SIGINT, asserting exit 0 and non-empty output (interactive_start, scyllatop_test.py:44-60). Then starts it again, runs 10s c-s write on node1, SIGINTs and asserts only exit 0. Intended to test the interactive (urwid) UI, but stdout is a pipe so scyllatop takes the `not sys.stdout.isatty()` branch (tools/scyllatop/scyllatop.py, main) and runs dumpToStdout -- the same path as batch mode, with no iteration limit.
